plugins.name: growthnation
plugins.description: The GrowthNation MCP connector — plug your agent into your company's Agentic Transformation OS. Sign in once (OAuth) and your agent gets your department's AI skill library as tools (generated from voice interviews with your team, security-audited, versioned, feedback-improving) plus your company's connected tools — Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Asana, Apollo, Fireflies, Fathom, Granola and more — through one gateway. Built-in: start-interview, department-audit, create-skill, report-feedback. No API keys — just sign in.
